gloss: to relax, to feel at ease

definitions.gloss: to relax, to feel at ease, to make oneself comfortable
definitions.explanation: To spend time in a relaxed, comfortable state; to unwind.

examples.japanese: ⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧くつろぐ。
⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧くつろいで⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please make yourself comfortable at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧くつろぐ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}きだ→好き：02355_suki⟧。
examples.english: I like relaxing at home on weekends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、⟦お{風呂|ふろ}→お風呂：00802_ofuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧くつろぎたい。
examples.english: After work is done, I want to take a bath and relax.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、「⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧くつろいで⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: When my friend came over, I said, "Please make yourself at home."

notes:
くつろぐ means to relax and feel comfortable, typically in a physical and mental sense.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)
- Pattern: [person]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧[place]⟦で→で：00502_de⟧くつろぐ

ASPECT (ている):
- くつろいで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = is relaxing (ongoing action)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧くつろぐ (to relax at home)
- ⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧くつろぐ (to relax on the sofa)
- ⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧くつろぐ (to relax leisurely)

POLITE USAGE:
- ⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧おくつろぎ⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ (Please make yourself comfortable)
- Used by hosts to guests

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦リラックス→リラックス：02531_rirakkusu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to relax (loanword, more casual)
- ⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧: to rest
- ⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}く→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧: to calm down, settle down
